$comment: verify's recorded exceptions: every line of `python3 -m zabbix_api_extract verify` that is not a defect of the description, with the source reason. A key is `<version> <CODE> <api> <path>`, globs allowed. verify fails on a new line and on a stale exception (tools/ZabbixApiExtract/zabbix_api_extract/verify.py).

exceptions.reason: server-maintained interface columns (available, error, errors_from, disable_until): CHostInterface::checkInput's allow-list (array_flip, 7.0:255, 7.4:254, 8.0:247) refuses them; verify reads array_diff_key allow-lists, not this array_flip one (DOC-X-04)

CAction's shared operation writers store opconditions/opinventory when an operation carries them, but recovery operations are validated by strict API_OBJECTS rules that name neither (CAction::getOperationValidationRules(ACTION_RECOVERY_OPERATION), 8.0:2469), so the server refuses them
as recovery operations: update operations' strict rules (CAction::getOperationValidationRules(ACTION_UPDATE_OPERATION), 8.0:2482) name neither opconditions nor opinventory

7.0 stores links it checks by hand (CMap::create, 7.0:1800); its rule names them from 7.4 (CMap.php 7.4:622), which is the since the model records. The client gates only removed fields, so a 7.0 caller sends links

host.massadd hands interfaces to API::HostInterface()->massAdd (CHost.php 8.0:865), whose allow-list takes these (CHostInterface.php 8.0:247); verify never follows another API method (overlay extraFields list:hostinterface.create)

CHost::updateForce hands each host to massUpdate as array_diff_key(host, …) plus a rebuilt 'hosts' key (CHost.php 7.0:840-872), which stores the hosts row these columns belong to; verify loses the request through the rebuilt array. 8.0 validates them itself
a closed set of durations in seconds (10 to 3600), not named defines: an int is the value
a page's display period: 0 (the dashboard's) or a duration in seconds, not named defines
one field, two enums by item type: HTTP_AUTH_* for HTTP agent items, ITEM_AUTHTYPE_* for SSH items (API_MULTIPLE by type, CItemGeneral.php 8.0:331); kept an int
0 or SERVER_CHECK_INTERVAL: an interval in seconds (10), not an enum
1-5 is the week of the month only for monthly periods; daily and weekly periods take an interval in days or weeks (CMaintenance.php 8.0:362), so every is a number
role_rule.value_str grows from 255 (schema.inc.php 7.0:8749, 7.4:8333) to 2048 (8.0:8514); the record carries the newest length and a 7.x server refuses the excess itself
API_STRINGS_UTF8 of tag fields or 'extend' (CHost.php 7.0:2009): ZabbixOutput is exactly that shape
as template.massadd (CTemplate.php 7.4:489)
a first pass takes parameters as API_OBJECT with API_ALLOW_UNEXPECTED (CMediatype.php 7.0:302,404, a PHP array); the per-type rules validate the list (API_OBJECTS, 7.0:643,671)
a window of no type takes only an empty list (CCepRule.php 8.0:561), every other type a list of tag names when group_by_tags is on (8.0:597): a list of text; verify composes the two passes as one
a module's configuration is its manifest's free-form object (CModule.php 8.0:138); the API names no fields
type is API_REQUIRED for every shape map.create is given (CMap.php 8.0:2403); verify reads the shape validation, inside if (array_key_exists('shapes', …)), as conditional

a macro config's type is required whenever a config is given to a new macro (CTemplate::getMacroConfigValidationRules); verify reads the validation, inside if (array_key_exists('config', …)), as conditional

recorded deviation: CDRule::validateDChecks requires type by hand (check_db_fields, 8.0:514); NetworkDiscoveryCheckRequest serves create and update and stays optional, the server refusing a check without type
details are required for SNMP interfaces only (CHostInterface::checkSnmpInput, type == INTERFACE_TYPE_SNMP); optional is right for every other type
version is required for SNMP details only, as details are
